notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition and Activities are governmental funds here), so business_type is null. Basis for receipts/disbursements: Statement of Cash Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, Total Governmental Funds column (p5-6); balance sheet from Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1). Taxes line split using statement of activities (p2); State Sources split to carve out nameplate capacity (p3 and fund schedules); Non-Revenue Receipts split into insurance adjustments (p10) and the rest. Debt Service line split using the fund schedules (p17-19); the Madison Educational Facilities Leasing Corporation (blended) column's Other Local Receipts 786,290 and Debt Service 786,290 are the Special Building Fund's debt payments passed through the corporation; the Statement of Activities (p2) eliminates them (Debt Service 1,037,509 = 1,823,799 - 786,290), so both are recorded as an intra-entity transfer in/out (as for Columbus), not as receipts or spending. Hidden transfer: General Fund line 2650 Vehicle Operation, Maintenance, & Purchasing 250,000 (p11) equals the Depreciation Fund transfer from the General Fund (p13); the statement's Operations and Maintenance 1,339,072 still includes it, so I removed it from spending and recorded transfers_out 250,000 (computed), with printed transfers_in 250,000 (net total column). Because of these, disbursement items (11,811,012) differ from printed total 12,847,301 by the 250,000 and 786,290 reclassifications (includes_split) and 1 rounding; receipt items differ from 13,476,290 by the 786,290. Printed roll-forward ties: 7,392,600 + 13,476,290 - 12,847,301 + 250,000 = 8,271,589; my items give 7,392,600 + 12,690,000 - 11,811,012 + 1,036,290 - 1,036,290 = 8,271,588 due to 1 rounding in the printed disbursements. Detail: General Fund budget schedule (p9-12) is used for General Fund (more detailed than the General Fund components statement p7 and combining statement p8, which are not duplicated); the County Treasurer schedules (p21-22) and Other Governmental combining (p8) duplicate fund schedules and are not recorded. Detail lines with zero actual (and budget-only lines such as 1910, 6200 Title I ESEA, Budget Contingency, 4700) are omitted except 2211 shown at 0. Spending detail has no object breakdown, so detail_category is 'not itemized'. General Fund detail total 9,822,556 includes the 67,400 transfer (shown as other financing); the 250,000 reclassified transfer is also in other financing, so expenditure lines sum to 9,505,156 (printed less both transfers). Mid-schedule rounding of 1 in printed subtotals noted in report_discrepancies. Pages p1-p22 map to report pages 5-10, 31, 33, 34-47. Read pages 1-22 of 22. Intermediate Sources 54,980 split per p9 into 2110 County Fines and Licenses 48,919 (fines and forfeitures) and 2210 ESU Receipts 6,061.
